newsitem.title: USA: Showers possible for W.Europe, clearing later - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Showers possible for W.Europe, clearing later - WSC.

text.p: Western Europe will have a chance of showers from Friday into the weekend with below normal temperatures, lingering in the east but clearing in the west on Monday with temperatures warming slightly to near to below normal, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Some rain is expected to penetrate previously dry areas of England and France during Friday and early Saturday. More rain is needed however to ease the very dry conditions, WSC said.
In the British Isles the showers will clear on Saturday. Sunday and Monday will be dry and temperatures will be near to above normal, and warmest by Monday.
Germany and central Europe will have a chance of showers throughout the period. Temperatures will be near to below normal.
Mediterranean Europe will also have a chance of showers developing in the west with cooling temperatures and fair and mild weather over the east.
In Scandinavia light rain and possible mixed precipitation will move eastward across the south Saturday to Monday. It will be cool.

Eastern Europe should be dry on Saturday with milder temperatures developing. There are chances of showers in the northwest on Sunday and in central areas on Monday with temperatures mostly near normal.
Very cool weather will be replaced by milder temperatures in eastern Europe and eventually the western former Soviet Union in the coming days, WSC said.

The western FSU will have the change of showers with cool weather in the northeast on Saturday but dry weather and milder temperatures elsewhere. It will be mostly dry with mild temperatures regionwide on Sunday and will continue mild but with showers in the northwest by Monday.
